title_it: Lena, Kaffeehaus Nord Berlino (tedesca): Marea 2 Plus, vapore debole + secondo guasto in coda (sputa)
title_en: Lena, Kaffeehaus Nord Berlin (German): Marea 2 Plus, weak steam + second fault queued (spits)

lines.cue: Good morning, Sereni service, Michael speaking. How can I help you?
lines.text: Hello, this is Lena from Kaffeehaus Nord in Berlin. It is about our Marea 2 Plus.

lines.cue: Hello Lena. What is the problem?
lines.text: The steam is very weak. Foaming the milk takes forever, and the milk gets hot before it is foamed.
lines.expect_it: Apre «Vapore debole o lancia che gocciola», passo 1.

lines.cue: Is it weak steam, or does the wand drip with the tap closed?
lines.text: Weak steam, it does not drip. And also another thing: when I take out the portafilter after the coffee, it spits, it sprays coffee everywhere.
lines.expect_it: Tu scegli «Vapore debole» → passo pressione caldaia. Secondo sintomo «Sputa» messo IN CODA (messaggio).

lines.cue: We do one thing at a time. Where is the boiler needle: at 1.1, 1.2 bar?
lines.text: The needle is at one point two.
lines.expect_it: Tu scegli «Sì» → passo pulizia del beccuccio.

lines.cue: Unscrew the steam tip, put it thirty minutes in hot water with a cleaning tablet, then a pin through the holes, and refit it.
lines.text: Okay. I did it, the holes were half closed with milk. Now the steam is strong again. Fixed.
lines.expect_it: Clicca «Risolto da remoto»: blocco «Cosa fare ora» (remoto). Sotto, «In attesa: Sputa» con il pulsante Avvia: cliccalo.

lines.cue: Great. Now the other problem. At the end of the shot, do you hear the short discharge into the drip tray?
lines.text: No, I hear nothing. Before there was a short pssh sound, now nothing.
lines.expect_it: Tu scegli «Nessuno scarico» → passo data lavaggio.

lines.cue: When did you last backflush with a tablet?
lines.expect_it: Tu scegli «Più di una settimana» → passo lavaggio, manutenzione saltata.

lines.cue: Please backflush with a tablet, five cycles, then try again.
lines.text: I did the five cycles. It still spits.
lines.expect_it: Tu scegli «Sputa ancora» → passo corpo valvola.

lines.cue: Can you open the solenoid valve body, three fittings with a 17 spanner, and clean the plunger?
lines.text: I opened it. The small plunger inside is scratched, and the rubber is broken.
lines.expect_it: Tu scegli «Pistoncino danneggiato» → esito: elettrovalvola GE-2160 CON IL SERVICE, frase pronta.

lines.cue: You need the solenoid valve kit GE-2160. Fitting needs our service on the line: I ship it from Rotterdam and we book a call when it arrives. Serial number?
lines.text: The serial is zero four eight, five three zero.
lines.expect_it: Scheda macchina 048530: Kaffeehaus Nord, in garanzia fino a luglio 2027.

lines.cue: Under warranty, no charge. We call you when it arrives. Goodbye Lena.
lines.expect_it: «Chiudi chiamata» → resoconto con DUE sintomi: remoto + ricambio con service.
